name: @caddymate/db
description: Supabase migrations, generated types, RLS policies and seeds.

scripts.test: echo 'db tests run against local supabase (pnpm db:test)'
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --db-url "postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/caddymate_test?sslmode=disable" --schema public > src/database.types.ts && prettier --write src/database.types.ts
